properties.name: Suez Canal
properties.note: The member ways of OpenStreetMap's Suez Canal waterway relation (relation 7719838), including the New Suez Canal branch. A centreline: OpenStreetMap maps the canal's water mostly as sea behind the coastline, with water areas only for the lakes and the stretch north of Suez, so there is no one area for the whole canal.
